page.overview:
Who is Adhesive Explosive?

Adhesive Explosive, known as Instantaneous Bomber in the Japanese version, is a character version of the card, "Adhesive Explosive" — part of Yu-Gi-Oh!.

Adhesive Explosive appears in the video games, Yu-Gi-Oh! GX Spirit Caller and Yu-Gi-Oh!

World Championship 2008. Their team name is Startled Mad.
